snippet.title: Cloudscrapers - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Cloudscrapers is a minimalist strategy game with a relaxing vibe. Build the highest tower, manage resources, upgrade your building tools and discover mysteries hidden in the clouds.

Our demo is coming to Steam on NOVEMBER 17.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562200/Cloudscrapers/
